reviews.title: Highly recommend. Very impressive
reviews.comment: Outstanding performance! Look amazing, and for the amount of air flow they're pushing, the noise level is pretty decent, not very loud very respectable. But the static pressure level is insane. Highly recommend. Great value. Very easy to install.
reviews.author: Andrey Shabura

reviews.title: Pushes air through the radiator
reviews.comment: Much better airflow through the radiator than my old fans. Now I can actually feel the airflow through the top of my pc case. Very happy with these. Not very quiet though, but I don't mind.
reviews.author: Tristan G.

reviews.title: Great fans
reviews.comment: I got both the 140s and these 120's to upgrade the stock fans from my case. Nice, sturdy feeling fans. The bearings seem great too, easy spin and little to no noise at idle speeds. At moderate to max speeds these things move a ton of air to help maintain proper temp inside the case (my cat very much enjoys sitting near by or on top of the case-much to my great annoyance-when I'm gaming and absorb the hot air). Well made fans, not overly pricy or stupid cheap. Very nice middle ground. The RGB lights aren't anything special, what you'd expect, but they tie it all in of course.
reviews.author: Becca

reviews.title: Beautiful Fans for an Excellent Price
reviews.comment: Great fans for the price. There is no objective negative about these fans. They're inexpensive for the price and quality. If they didn't have wires except for the fan connecting to the motherboard or no wires at all would be perfect. They also work on AIOs if you want to do that. They don't seem to suffer the blinking issue like the AIO stock fans.
reviews.author: Robert

reviews.title: Nice buy worth it
reviews.comment: Argd is very bright as simple to put in as any other wired cpu fan do feel very light and cheap but are still sturdy and very quiet have nice look and in my opinion worth the money and have good airflow
